title: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Davao Leg 3 Review: A Unique 32K Distance in Mindanao
seo_title: Sante Barley Run Davao Leg 3 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 Davao Leg 3: September 27 at Azuela Cove. 32K, 21K, 10K, 5K from Runrio — featuring one of the rarest distances in Philippine racing.
dek: Set for 27 September 2026 at Azuela Cove in Davao City, this Runrio-produced Sante Barley series leg features a rare 32K distance alongside the standard 21K, 10K, and 5K.
verdict: The Sante Barley Trilogy Run Davao Leg 3 is notable for one thing above all: a 32K distance — roughly three-quarters of a marathon — that almost no other Philippine race offers. Produced by Runrio at Azuela Cove, Davao's premier waterfront development, the event also offers standard 21K, 10K, and 5K distances. The 32K is a genuine stepping-stone for marathon aspirants and a distinctive challenge for experienced runners. Registration isn't open yet, but for the 32K alone, this is worth tracking.

sections.heading: The 32K: A Rare Stepping Stone
paragraphs: The 32K distance sits in the gap between the half marathon and the full — a distance that tests marathon-readiness without the full 42K commitment. [1] Azuela Cove is Davao's premier waterfront estate, providing a scenic, flat course with views over the Davao Gulf. Runrio's production ensures professional standards.
